draftRows.difficultyWhy: Distinguish ruling out a candidate fault from identifying it, after linking persistent failure in the original device to success in a spare using the same cables.

draftActiveQuestion.prompt: The lab checked the cables before retesting the scanner, but the fault persisted. A spare scanner of the same model then worked with the same cables, so the team could ____ the cables as the source of the fault.
draftActiveQuestion.promptZh: 實驗室檢查接線後重新測試掃描器，但故障仍在。接著，同型號的備用掃描器接上同一批線材卻能正常運作，因此團隊可以____線材是故障來源的可能性。

options.whyZh: 備用掃描器沿用同一批線材仍能運作，不能據此認定線材就是故障來源。
檢查接線後原掃描器仍故障，但相同線材可搭配同型號的備用掃描器正常使用，支持排除線材是故障來源。
可重現的是故障或症狀，不是線材；備用掃描器也沒有出現同一個故障。
兩次測試是在釐清故障來源，不是在補救線材不足。

draftActiveQuestion.explanationZh: 檢查接線後原掃描器仍故障，但相同線材可搭配同型號的備用掃描器正常使用，支持排除線材是故障來源。
draftActiveQuestion.evidence: the fault persisted […] a spare scanner of the same model then worked with the same cables

vocabulary.note: 在診斷中表示根據證據排除某個可能原因。

draftRows.difficultyWhy: Separate supplier availability from a formal permission gate; compare grammatical conditional and concessive options that imply opposing rules.

draftActiveQuestion.prompt: The supplier says it can deliver the substitute fasteners today. Production may use them ____ the signed change notice is filed before the first unit is assembled; with no notice on file, the fasteners must stay in stock even if approval was given by phone.
draftActiveQuestion.promptZh: 供應商表示今天可以交付替代扣件。產線可以使用這些扣件，____在組裝第一台之前，完成已簽署變更通知的歸檔；要是沒有歸檔，即使已取得電話核准，扣件也只能留在庫房。

options.whyZh: 後文明示沒有歸檔就不能領用；even if 在這裡會把歸檔說成不影響使用許可，與規定相反。
unless 會讓句意變成未歸檔時才可使用，正好顛倒規定。
供應商能交貨不等於產線可使用；必須在首台組裝前將已簽署的變更通知歸檔，才符合使用條件。
as though 引出假設情況，不能設定是否可使用替代扣件的正式條件。

draftActiveQuestion.explanationZh: 供應商能交貨不等於產線可使用；必須在首台組裝前將已簽署的變更通知歸檔，才符合使用條件。
draftActiveQuestion.evidence: the signed change notice is filed before the first unit is assembled; with no notice on file, the fasteners must stay in stock

vocabulary.note: 在正式紀錄中登錄並保存文件。

draftRows.difficultyWhy: Use the relationship among the ticket price, the deposit and the remaining amount to distinguish a credit toward a purchase from a refund or additional fee.

draftActiveQuestion.prompt: A workshop ticket costs $40, and Inez paid $15 to hold her place. The receipt says that payment will be ____ the ticket price, so only $25 is due at check-in.
draftActiveQuestion.promptZh: 工作坊票價為 40 元，Inez 已先付 15 元保留名額。收據註明，這筆款項將____票價，因此報到時只需再付 25 元。

options.whyZh: 已付的 15 元算進 40 元票價，因此報到時只須付餘額 25 元。
如果 15 元加到原票價上，總費用會增加，而不是用這 15 元抵掉部分票款。
文中顯示保留名額的款項已抵票價，沒有說報到時會退回這筆款項。
若 15 元另計而不抵票價，原本的 40 元就不會因這筆付款而剩下 25 元。

draftActiveQuestion.explanationZh: 已付的 15 元算進 40 元票價，因此報到時只須付餘額 25 元。
draftActiveQuestion.evidence: costs $40 […] paid $15 […] so only $25 is due

vocabulary.note: 把一筆已付款金額計入某筆應付費用。

draftRows.difficultyWhy: The inverted past-perfect condition and the explicit present inability jointly distinguish an unreal past result from a future prediction or an ability that actually existed.

draftActiveQuestion.prompt: The team can no longer check how the battery performed during the blackout because the backup logger was disconnected. Had the logger stayed connected, the team ____ the missing readings.
draftActiveQuestion.promptZh: 由於備用資料記錄器當時已斷開連線，團隊現在無法確認停電期間的電池表現。如果當時記錄器仍保持連線，團隊就____缺少的讀值。

options.whyZh: 這會把結果寫成未來可能實現的能力，與文中現在已無法查到讀值相反。
這指當時已實際找回，但記錄器已斷線，這些讀值並沒有找回。
otherwise 會再引入另一個條件； recover 也沒有表達此處對已過去、未成真的結果所需的完成式。

options.text: would have been able to recover
options.whyZh: Had the logger stayed connected 等於 If the logger had stayed connected；它假設過去發生了不同的情況，所以用 would have been able to 表達未能實現的能力。

draftActiveQuestion.explanationZh: Had the logger stayed connected 等於 If the logger had stayed connected；它假設過去發生了不同的情況，所以用 would have been able to 表達未能實現的能力。
draftActiveQuestion.evidence: can no longer check […] Had the logger stayed connected

vocabulary.note: 自動擷取並儲存設備讀值的裝置。

draftRows.difficultyWhy: Distinguish reconciling discrepancies between two independently maintained sources from simply merging, duplicating or relabeling records.

draftActiveQuestion.prompt: The warehouse log and the packing slips show different counts for the same shipments. Before sending the figures to finance, please ____ the two sets of records without changing either original.
draftActiveQuestion.promptZh: 倉庫紀錄與裝箱單對同一批出貨列出的數量不同。在將數字交給財務部門前，請先____這兩套紀錄，不要更改任何一份原始資料。

options.whyZh: 兩套紀錄的出貨數量不一致，應逐筆比對，查明差異並確認正確數字；不必修改原始文件。
彙整資料能把紀錄放在一起，但無法單靠合併就解決同批貨的數量差異。
多做一份副本不會釐清哪個出貨數字正確。
重新分類會調整項目歸屬，但目前要釐清的是同批出貨數量不一致，而非分類有誤。

draftActiveQuestion.explanationZh: 兩套紀錄的出貨數量不一致，應逐筆比對，查明差異並確認正確數字；不必修改原始文件。
draftActiveQuestion.evidence: different counts for the same shipments […] without changing either original

vocabulary.note: 比對不同來源的紀錄，找出不一致並說明差異。

draftRows.difficultyWhy: Resolve whether a past action happened and whether it was necessary before choosing the modal; avoid mistaking an unnecessary completed action for a recommendation or an impossibility.

draftActiveQuestion.prompt: Your log shows that you reinstalled the printer driver before calling support. The problem was only a paused print queue, so you ____ the driver.
draftActiveQuestion.promptZh: 你的紀錄顯示，你在聯絡客服前已重新安裝印表機驅動程式。不過問題只是列印佇列已暫停，所以你____驅動程式。

options.whyZh: 紀錄顯示你確實重新安裝了驅動程式，不能說當時不可能重裝。
問題出在列印佇列暫停，不需要重裝；紀錄也顯示這個動作已經做了。

options.zh: 當時其實不必重新安裝
options.whyZh: 句首確認你已實際重新安裝；但只須恢復列印佇列，所以以 need not have 表達做了卻沒有必要。
這表示用線索推斷動作一定發生；這裡不是要從列印佇列故障推定你一定重裝，而是說重裝其實不必要。

draftActiveQuestion.explanationZh: 句首確認你已實際重新安裝；但只須恢復列印佇列，所以以 need not have 表達做了卻沒有必要。
draftActiveQuestion.evidence: Your log shows that you reinstalled […] only a paused print queue

vocabulary.note: 系統用來等候並安排列印工作的清單。
